Correct: wrong position, contradicts the entry's own placement rule.
Note says before be; its own correction and other notes say after be.
Same contradiction with the synonym and adaptation notes.
Slight overstatement; sentence-initial use is a separate sense, so this is a small point.
'similarly' is not a confusable for point-adding 'Also'; 'in addition' fits better.
Position rules repeated across synonym note, adaptation note and learner errors.
